user.title: Flagdays DK
user.description: Basic settings. You can add custom flagdays afterwards via "Configure".

data_description.offset: Minutes before flag up/down, used for triggers e.g. automations. Default: 10
data_description.include: Name of a special flag (e.g. Erfalasorput) or part of a flagday name
data_description.exclude: Flagdays whose name contains this text are excluded. "all" hides all default flagdays.
data_description.exclude_custom: Add or remove further strings manually.

abort.already_configured: Flagdays DK is already set up.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Only a single instance is allowed.

data_description.offset: Minutes before flag up/down, used for triggers e.g. automations. Default: 10
data_description.include: Name of a special flag (e.g. Erfalasorput) or part of a flagday name
data_description.exclude: Flagdays whose name contains this text are excluded. "all" hides all default flagdays.
data_description.exclude_custom: Add or remove further strings manually.

add_flagday.title: Add custom flagday
add_flagday.description: Date as day-month-year (e.g. 7-2-1957, the age is calculated) or day-month (e.g. 7-2). End date and flag are optional.

data_description.date_end: For prolonged flagdays: day-month (e.g. 10-1), in the same year as the start date.
data_description.flag: Name of a special flag, e.g. Erfalasorput or Merkið. Empty = Dannebrog.

sensors.title: Sensors as source
sensors.description: Sensors (or groups of sensors) with a date attribute, e.g. from Anniversaries, are added as flagdays. Changes to the sensors are only picked up after the integration is reloaded.

data_description.sensors: Sensor or group entities. The friendly name of the sensor becomes the name of the flagday.
data_description.attribute_names: The first existing attribute holding a date is used. Default: date

error.invalid_date: Invalid date. Format: day-month-year or day-month (e.g. 7-2-1957).
error.name_exists: A custom flagday with this name already exists.
error.date_end_before_start: The end date must not be before the start date.
